evidence_quotes.O: I would buy my film in bulk, load it into casettes, shoot, then develop and print in my home darkroom.
evidence_quotes.C: My first screen shows total time elapsed, speed in MPH, total distance and heart rate.

evidence_quotes.N: it becomes nonresponsive until I wipe off the sweat. But this is not a big deal for me.
